mentions.name: AdamEyes
mentions.description: AdamEyes is a horizontal infrastructure that mimics human-like vision, enabling any camera to have intelligence and behave like a true human vision system. It serves as a foundation over which robotics and computer vision applications can be built, targeting use cases such as robotics navigation, drone surveillance, elderly care CCTV cameras, and intelligent CCTV cameras, while avoiding the need for expensive systems in robotics and machine perception.
mentions.problem: Basic robotics and machine perception applications like navigation and surveillance currently require expensive systems; AdamEyes aims to provide affordable human-like vision intelligence for any camera.
